card.head: Health care costs, recorded, never judged.
card.sub: A tour of the Health page, on a made-up sample household.

scenes.say: Groundwork 2.0 adds a Health page. Everything you'll see here belongs to a made-up sample household.
Medical bills, your plan year, a health reserve and your HSA now sit together, on one page.
A bill is kept exactly as the provider sent it. It becomes something you owe only when you say it's yours.
When a card charge might be the same bill, Groundwork counts both until you say so. It never guesses.

scenes.focus: __span('Your leanest month', 'months: your record sustains this.')
scenes.say: It shows which monthly amounts your own record can sustain. It never tells you what to offer, and it never contacts anyone.

scenes.do: const s = [...document.querySelectorAll('summary')].find(e => e.textContent.includes('went to collections')); if (s) s.click();
scenes.focus: __find('This bill went to collections').closest('details') || __find('This bill went to collections')
scenes.say: If a bill goes to collections, it stays here with its own running balance, never in your debt plan, and nothing is added that the collector didn't send.
Your deductible and out-of-pocket maximum are shown as your insurer reports them. Groundwork never works them out from your spending.
A health reserve is money set aside in an account you already have, aimed at the most a covered year can cost.

scenes.focus: __span('HEALTH SPENDING, AS RECORDED', 'this month so far')
scenes.say: Health spending is a record, not a budget. There's no limit to beat, and Groundwork never suggests spending less on care.
Say whom care was for, payment by payment. The visit report and the year in review are ready to print when you need them.
Names are labels, not locks, and the page says so plainly. You can hide Health from the sidebar at any time.

card.head: Nothing about your health leaves your computer.
card.sub: Free for Windows, macOS and Linux · groundworkfinance.app

scenes.say: And nothing about your health ever leaves your computer. Groundwork 2.0 is free.
